thread:
maria: heads up — seeing a weird auth failure in Dedicated-West after yesterday's RBAC role-mapping regen. onprem admins can't reach private control plane UI. any ideas?
jon: repro? paste the exact error/log line if you have it.
maria: yeah paste below from the audit stream: 
```
audit.v1.auth: time=2025-11-03T14:02:11Z action=impersonate target=svcacct-onprem-admin principal=svcacct-dedicated-proxy result=DENIED reason=allowlist-mismatch cluster=dedicated-west
```
alex: hmm that looks like the mapping between the dedicated proxy SA and onprem admin role wasn't carried over by the migration. the regen script skipped clusters that had a non-empty custom-allowlist.
sophia: @maria can you confirm the cluster had custom allowlist entries? iirc dedicated-west has two tenant entries added manually.
maria: yes, dedicated-west has manual VPC allowlist entries and a handful of exempted svcacct bindings.
carlos: possible sequence: regen removed the explicit svcacct->role binding and relied on the new template which expects the proxy to present an impersonation token that matches allowlist patterns. tokens don't match because svcacct names were suffixed by tenant ids.
jon: also seeing KMS errors for the same cluster in the last 30m: 
```
secrets.kms: time=2025-11-03T14:03:05Z key=tenant-8423 decrypt=FAIL reason=AccessDenied principal=svcacct-onprem-admin
```
alex: that implies the onprem-admin role doesn't have Decrypt permission on tenant keys anymore. RBAC refactor probably scoped KMS principals tighter.
sophia: quick triage plan: 1) freeze regen script, 2) revert role-mapping for dedicated-west from backup, 3) run a granular audit to list clusters with custom allowlists and compare bindings.
maria: agree. i paused the next-run in the deploy pipeline (thanks deploy-bot).
deploy-bot: pipeline/dag/rbac-regen disabled by maria at 2025-11-03T14:15:02Z :rotating_light:
jon: commands i'd run: `rbacctl list-mapping --cluster dedicated-west --output yaml` and `rbacctl who-can decrypt --key tenant-8423`. also check `audit.search "action=impersonate cluster=dedicated-west"`.
carlos: i'll restore the pre-regeneration mapping from s3://rbac-backups/2025-11-02-dump.json and then run the two checks. if KMS perms still fail, we'll need a temporary grant to the onprem-admin role.
sophia: can we do a short-lived grant via iam-temporal to limit blast radius? prefer time-bound fix.
alex: sg. i'll draft the PR to add an automated safety check in the regen job to skip clusters with custom allowlists and to emit affected-clusters list. also adding unit test for svcacct name patterns.
maria: thanks. priority: restore access for onprem admins + confirm no other clusters affected, then postmortem on why regen ignored allowlist.
jon: marking incident Sev-2 for access-impacting change, creating incident ticket INC-2025-874 in pagerduty.
carlos: doing restore now, will post results in 15.
maria: thx — tagging security oncall for visibility: @sophia. :eyes:
